Our experience spans government, finance, and healthcare — where reliability, security, and efficiency are non-negotiable.

Services.title: Process Automation
Services.subtitle: Eliminate manual work at scale
Services.description: Manual processes are a hidden tax on your organization — they slow delivery, introduce errors, and consume your team's most valuable hours. We analyze, map, and replace repetitive workflows with automated systems that operate faster, more accurately, and around the clock.
outcomes: Error reduction and full audit trails
Integration with existing tools and databases

Services.title: Custom Web Applications
Services.subtitle: Enterprise platforms built to last
Services.description: Off-the-shelf software is built for the average use case — your organization isn't average. We design and develop web applications precisely fitted to your requirements, built for reliability, security, and the scale of users you need to serve.

Services.title: System Integration
Services.subtitle: Connect your digital infrastructure
Services.description: Most organizations run multiple systems that don't communicate. The result is manual data transfer, duplicate entry, and broken workflows. We build integrations that connect your existing tools — from legacy databases to modern APIs — into a cohesive ecosystem.

Services.title: Government Digital Solutions
Services.subtitle: Purpose-built for the public sector
Services.description: Government software demands absolute reliability, security, audit trails, and the ability to serve thousands of citizens simultaneously. Our team has delivered multiple national-level platforms — we know what high-stakes public software requires from day one.

Services.title: Internal Enterprise Tools
Services.subtitle: Tools that fit how you actually work
Services.description: Generic SaaS products force your workflows into shapes they were never designed for. We build internal tools — dashboards, approval systems, case management, reporting — that match exactly how your team operates, not the other way around.

Services.title: Data & Reporting
Services.subtitle: Visibility into what matters
Services.description: Operational data is only valuable if you can read it. We build reporting layers, live dashboards, and analytics systems that give leadership and operational teams real-time visibility into performance, bottlenecks, and trends.

Process.title: Discovery
Process.description: We map your current processes, define requirements, and identify the highest-impact opportunities for improvement.

Process.title: Design
Process.description: We design the system architecture and user experience before writing a single line of code.

Process.title: Development
Process.description: Iterative development with regular demos. You see progress at every stage and can give feedback early.

Process.title: Launch & Support
Process.description: We handle deployment and provide ongoing support to ensure the system performs exactly as designed.

Values.title: Engineering Excellence
Values.description: We hold our work to the same standards as the largest enterprise systems — because the organizations we serve depend on it.

Values.title: Business Understanding
Values.description: We don't just implement requirements. We understand the business context behind them — so the software we deliver solves the right problem.

Values.title: Transparent Delivery
Values.description: No surprises. You see what we're building at every step. We communicate proactively about progress, blockers, and decisions.

Values.title: Long-term Thinking
Values.description: We build for the future, not just the deadline. Our systems are designed to scale, adapt, and remain maintainable for years.

Projects.title: On Road Networks
Projects.overview: All-in-one fleet management and FMCSA-compliant ELD platform for trucking companies — combining driver hours logging, GPS tracking, and a driver-first mobile app.
Projects.problem: Trucking fleets managed compliance, tracking, and driver coordination across disconnected tools and paper logbooks with no real-time visibility and constant risk of FMCSA violations.
Projects.solution: Built an integrated platform with a driver mobile app and fleet back office — automating hours-of-service logging, real-time GPS tracking, route optimization, and offline history restoration.

Projects.title: Diyar
Projects.overview: Modern corporate web presence for Diyar, built for clarity, speed, and professional presentation.
Projects.problem: No digital platform to represent the company and reach clients online.
Projects.solution: Clean corporate website with structured content and fast performance.

Projects.title: KIT Forum
Projects.overview: Platform for Central Asia's largest digital technology and innovation forum — managing registrations, agenda, and attendee experience at scale.
Projects.problem: Thousands of registrations, speakers, and sessions with no unified system created logistical chaos.
Projects.solution: End-to-end event platform covering registrations, session scheduling, speaker profiles, and automated attendee communications.

Projects.title: Atria
Projects.overview: Blockchain platform enabling real estate tokenization and fractional property investment in Kyrgyzstan.
Projects.problem: Real estate was illiquid and inaccessible — large capital requirements locked out most investors.
Projects.solution: Tokenized property assets for fractional ownership and transparent digital trading on a blockchain ledger.

results.label: Real estate tokenization platform in Kyrgyzstan

Projects.title: Finipay
Projects.overview: Corporate payment platform with digital wallets, analytics, and ML fraud prevention for Kyrgyz businesses.
Projects.problem: SMEs juggling disconnected payment tools with no unified reporting or compliance.
Projects.solution: Finipay CORE — payment acceptance, corporate wallets, ML fraud prevention, and real-time financial analytics.

results.label: With major banks and international payment systems

Projects.title: Booka
Projects.overview: Multi-language SaaS letting service businesses automate client bookings 24/7 without phone calls.
Projects.problem: Clients lost after hours, staff overwhelmed with manual scheduling and no-show management.
Projects.solution: 24/7 self-booking with WhatsApp/SMS reminders, staff calendars, client analytics, and mobile apps.

Projects.title: Tinlake
Projects.overview: EdTech mini-app delivered entirely through Telegram, reaching learners without requiring a separate app install.
Projects.problem: Reaching students where they already spend time — inside Telegram — without the friction and drop-off of a native app download.
Projects.solution: Built a Telegram-native mini-app experience for EdTech content and interactions, distributed through the Tinlake bot.

Projects.title: Coin App (DIANA)
Projects.overview: Telegram-based investment bot letting users own virtual shares in ML server infrastructure and earn a share of rental revenue in COIN tokens.
Projects.problem: Give everyday users a simple way to invest in AI compute infrastructure without the technical barriers of running or renting servers themselves.
Projects.solution: Built the DIANA Telegram bot, letting users purchase virtual stakes in ML servers with automated payout of rental revenue in COIN tokens.

results.label: Rental revenue shared with token holders
